records.translation: communityCenter/-2000 -2000/farmer 9 8 3 Junimo 8 8 1/skippable/pause 1000/positionOffset Junimo 0 32/viewport 8 8 true/animate Junimo true true 50 16 17 18 19 20 21 22 23/pause 3000/playSound junimoMeep1/animate Junimo true true 50 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7/pause 3000/playSound junimoMeep1/animate Junimo true true 50 16 17 18 19 20 21 22 23/pause 3000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000 true/specificTemporarySprite junimoSpotlight/animate Junimo true true 50 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7/warp Junimo -1000 -1000/pause 3000/playSound junimoMeep1/spriteText 3 "其他夥伴都回去了，只有我還沒……"/playSound junimoMeep1/playMusic none/spriteText 3 "現在我也能回家了。謝謝你！謝謝你！"/pause 1000/animate Junimo true true 100 28 29 30 31/playSound junimoMeep1/pause 5000/screenFlash 1/warp Junimo -9999 -9999/specificTemporarySprite missingJunimoStars/playSound wand/pause 4000/playSound boulderCrack/pause 50/playSound boulderCrack/pause 130/playSound boulderCrack/pause 140/playSound boulderCrack/pause 177/playSound boulderCrack/pause 330/playSound boulderCrack/pause 180/playSound boulderCrack/pause 67/playSound boulderCrack/pause 230/playSound boulderCrack/pause 88/playSound boulderCrack/pause 128/pause 200/playSound boulderCrack/pause 50/playSound boulderCrack/pause 130/playSound boulderCrack/pause 140/playSound boulderCrack/pause 177/playSound boulderCrack/pause 330/playSound boulderCrack/pause 380/playSound boulderCrack/pause 67/playSound boulderCrack/pause 120/playSound boulderCrack/pause 88/playSound boulderCrack/spriteText 4 "很快就會發生好事……"/pause 1028/end

spring_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 42 11 0 Willy 47 7 0/skippable/specificTemporarySprite dickBag/viewport 47 5 clamp true/emote Willy 8/move farmer 0 -4 1/move farmer 4 0 1/faceDirection Willy 3/pause 500/speak Willy "嗨，@。"/pause 500/faceDirection Willy 0/speak Willy "真奇怪……不知道這塊巨石為什麼消失了。"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/speak Willy "這條溪流從山脈深處流出來。"/pause 1000/specificTemporarySprite dickGlitter/playSound slosh/pause 500/faceDirection Willy 2/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 500/jump Willy/pause 800/emote Willy 16/speak Willy "嘿！看到水裡閃閃發亮的東西了嗎？"/pause 800/showFrame Willy 24/pause 250/showFrame Willy 25/pause 1000/speak Willy "沒錯……那是上等礦石！$h"/showFrame Willy 24/pause 200/showFrame Willy 0/pause 500/faceDirection Willy 3/speak Willy "一定是水流把它從山裡沖了出來。"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 500/speak Willy "你知道這代表什麼，對吧？"/pause 900/jump Willy/pause 800/speak Willy "這代表我們可以開始淘礦了！$h"/faceDirection Willy 2/faceDirection Willy 3/speak Willy "來，我背包裡多了一個淘盤……你何不收下？"/pause 800/faceDirection Willy 1/pause 800/showFrame Willy 26/pause 500/playSound coin/pause 500/showFrame Willy 4/pause 500/showFrame Willy 12/faceDirection Willy 3/awardFestivalPrize Pan/null/pause 800/faceDirection Willy 2/speak Willy "以後看到水裡有礦石閃光，就用淘盤看看能找到什麼。"/faceDirection farmer 2/itemAboveHead pan/null/pause 1000/end

nightTime/-1000 -1000/farmer 23 29 3 Maru 14 29 3/skippable/bgColor 0 0 0/changeToTemporaryMap NightSceneMaruMap false/ambientLight 0 0 0/viewport 14 23 true/pause 2000/playSound leafrustle/pause 200/faceDirection Maru 1/pause 400/emote Maru 8/pause 800/move farmer -5 0 3/speak Maru "@！沒想到這麼晚還會在這裡看到你。"/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 1000/speak Maru "今晚的星空真美。"/faceDirection Maru 1/speak Maru "過來，我想給你看樣東西。"/move farmer -3 0 3/speak Maru "來，看看吧。"/move Maru 0 1 0/move farmer -1 0 3/pause 200/animate farmer true true 100 35/pause 1200/playMusic spaceMusic/speak Maru "$q 40 null#你看到了什麼？#$r 40 30 Event_Space1#一顆美麗的行星。#$r 40 -30 Event_Space2#冰冷黑暗的深淵。"/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/speak Maru "等到有人造訪這些星星時，你和我早已不在了……$8"/emote farmer 28/pause 400/speak Maru "我想，這就是身為人類的難處，對吧？"/faceDirection Maru 0/pause 1200/faceDirection Maru 2/emote Maru 40/pause 500/faceDirection Maru 0/speak Maru "@，呃……$8"/pause 500/faceDirection Maru 2/pause 1500/speak Maru "沒事……$s"/pause 500/faceDirection Maru 0/pause 800/speak Maru "來，我帶你看一個雙星系統……"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3 true/animate farmer true true 100 35/pause 800/specificTemporarySprite maruTelescope/viewport move 0 -1 16000/pause 16000/globalFade .003/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 500/message "多麼美麗的夜晚！瑪魯讓我見識了新的事物……"/pause 1000 /stopAnimation farmer/changeLocation Mountain/end

ocean/-2000 -2000/farmer 49 22 2/addTemporaryActor Willy 16 64 52 26 2/addCraftingRecipe Quality Bobber/skippable/specificTemporarySprite WillyWad/animate Willy false true 500 8 9 10 11/pause 1000/speak Willy "嘿嘿……牠們愛死了……看牠們搶得多起勁！$h"/pause 1000/playSound slosh/pause 500/playSound slosh/pause 500/playSound slosh/pause 500/viewport 52 24 true/pause 1000/move farmer 0 2 2/textAboveHead Willy "喂！"/pause 2000/speak Willy "我剛好在想你，小伙子。^我剛好在想你，小姐。#$b#你找到的蟲肉太完美了！#$b#嘿嘿……我說要「新鮮」，可沒料到它們還會扭動！#$b#不過我不抱怨！魚兒很喜歡……嘿嘿嘿……$h"/emote farmer 28 true/pause 300/playSound slimeHit/pause 500/playSound slimeHit/pause 500/playSound slimeHit/pause 1000/speak Willy "為了表示「感謝」，我想教你一個老漁夫的祕訣……這是多年前釣魚時，我老爸教我的。"/pause 500/playSound reward/message "學會製作「優質浮標」"/pause 500/speak Willy "使用那種浮標會吸引品質更高的魚。#$b#這代表口袋裡會有更多錢，小伙子。^這代表口袋裡會有更多錢，姑娘。嘿嘿……$h"/pause 1500/pause 300/playSound fishBite/pause 500/pause 400/playSound FishHit/animate Willy false true 100 17 18/textAboveHead Willy "上鉤了！"/shake Willy 5000/pause 200/playSound slosh/pause 200/playSound slosh/pause 220/playSound slosh/pause 160/playSound slosh/pause 200/playSound slosh/pause 220/playSound slosh/pause 160/playSound slosh/pause 200/playSound slosh/pause 220/playSound slosh/pause 160/playSound slosh/pause 200/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

Hospital_Ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer -10000 -10000 0 Maru 9 15 3 Harvey 7 10 0/skippable/changeSprite Maru Hospital/changePortrait Maru Hospital/showFrame Maru 18/viewport 10 15/pause 4000/speak Maru "*嘆氣*……我受夠準備這些樣本了……$s"/pause 2000/playSound doorClose/warp farmer 10 19/pause 100/playSound throw/showFrame Maru 17/shake Maru 2000/jump Maru/specificTemporarySprite maruBeaker/move farmer 0 -1 0/pause 1250/showFrame Maru 0/faceDirection Maru 2/pause 100/speak Maru "啊！哦，不！……$4"/pause 600/showFrame Maru 16/pause 1000/speak Maru "整份樣本都毀了……哈維會殺了我……$s"/pause 600/showFrame Maru 0/faceDirection Maru 0/pause 1500/faceDirection Maru 2/pause 400/speak Maru "$q 38 null#@，我該怎麼辦？#$r 38 -50 Event_Hospital_1#從地板上撈起來就好。他看不出差別。#$r 39 -20 Event_Hospital_2#告訴哈維是我的錯。#$r 38 50 Event_Hospital_3#告訴哈維這是意外。"/move Harvey 3 0 2/move Harvey 0 2 2/doAction 10 13/move Harvey 0 1 2/faceDirection Maru 1/speak Harvey "發生什麼事？我聽到有東西破了。"/pause 500/speak Maru "$p 38#我不小心摔了一份樣本……真的很抱歉。$s|@進來時把門甩得太大聲，害我摔了這份樣本。$u"/fork toldTruth/move Harvey 0 2 3/emote Harvey 40/speak Harvey "瑪魯，你不該把自己的問題怪在別人身上。$a"/pause 300/faceDirection Harvey 1/speak Harvey "*嘆氣*……我得打電話請病人回來重新採樣。$s#$b#這大概會害我們再虧損一個月……$s"/pause 600/faceDirection Maru 2/pause 1000/showFrame Maru 16/pause 500/emote farmer 28/end

pause 800/showFrame Elliott 0/animate Elliott false true 220 0 1 2 3/playSound woodyStep/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/pause 120/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/pause 120/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/pause 120/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/pause 120/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/pause 120/positionOffset Elliott 0 8/stopAnimation Elliott/faceDirection Elliott 2/pause 500/move Elliott 1 0 1 true/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 1500/showFrame Elliott 31/pause 800/emote Elliott 28/pause 800/speak Elliott "我日夜不停地工作，想把書寫完……快把我逼瘋了，@。$s"/showFrame Elliott 4/pause 800/move Elliott -2 0 0/pause 800/speak Elliott "偶爾彈首曲子，是我唯一允許自己的娛樂。$7"/pause 600/faceDirection Elliott 2/speak Elliott "要做的事實在太多了！而且我的銀行帳戶也快見底了。$7#$b#有時我真想拋下一切，像你一樣當個農民。$h"/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 0/question fork1 "#你知道嗎，當農民也一樣辛苦。#搬來農場住吧，我正需要多一個人幫忙。"/fork extraHelp/pause 500/emote Elliott 16/speak Elliott "你說得對……那樣說太不體貼了。$8"/move Elliott 0 1 3/faceDirection farmer 1/speak Elliott "我的意思是，想離開這座陰暗、霉味四溢的監獄，體驗一點真實生活……僅此而已。$s"/animate Elliott true true 100 31/pause 800/emote Elliott 28/pause 500/speak Elliott "*嘆氣*……抱歉一直向你抱怨。我只是偶爾需要有人聊聊。$7"/pause 500/stopAnimation Elliott/showFrame Elliott 4/pause 600/faceDirection Elliott 3/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

pause 400/speak Elliott "在書桌前塗寫了無數個小時後，我要向各位發表第一本小說：《山茶花車站》……這是一部描寫列車女服務員愛上旅行建築師的愛情小說……"/animate Elliott false true 1000 33 33 34/pause 500/speak Elliott "第一章。#$b#「先生，請出示車票？」驗票員戈茲曼向年輕的通勤乘客伸出戴著手套的手。「啊，好。就在這裡。」他回答，伸手探進大衣口袋。接著，他驚恐地發現車票不見了。"/playMusic none/globalFade/viewport -100 -100/pause 1000/warp Sebastian -1000 -1000/warp Sam -1000 -1000/warp Abigail -1000 -1000/warp Jodi -1000 -1000/warp Robin -1000 -1000/warp Demetrius -1000 -1000/warp Shane -1000 -1000/warp Maru -1000 -1000/warp Pierre -1000 -1000/warp Caroline -1000 -1000/viewport 14 11 true/pause 1000/speak Elliott "……「克拉拉，有件事我必須告訴你。」她轉身離去時，他脫口而出。克拉拉緩緩轉身，看見霍雷肖眼中的絕望。就在那一刻，戈茲曼滿臉通紅地衝進包廂。"/stopAnimation Elliott/showFrame Elliott 34/pause 800/speak Elliott "好了，朗讀就到這裡。我會在櫃檯旁販售親筆簽名的書。謝謝各位聆聽！$h"/faceDirection Lewis 3/faceDirection Marnie 1/faceDirection Emily 2 true/faceDirection Clint 1/move Elliott 0 4 3/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 600/speak Elliott "嗯，感覺怎麼樣？"/emote farmer 32/speak Elliott "謝謝。$h#$b#你知道嗎，我從你那裡得到了創作愛情小說的靈感。記得嗎？#$b#所以我把這本書獻給你……$l"/move Elliott -1 0 3/emote Elliott 32/pause 1000/end

AbigailFlute/-1000 -1000/farmer 34 32 1 Abigail 47 31 2/skippable/ambientLight 160 140 10/specificTemporarySprite abbyAtLake/animate Abigail false true 612 16 17 18 19/viewport 46 31 clamp true/pause 17900/move farmer 13 0 0/stopMusic/playMusic rain/pause 500/stopAnimation Abigail/faceDirection Abigail 2/emote Abigail 16/speak Abigail "$q 32 null#@！下雨天怎麼會跑到這裡？$7#$r 32 0 Event_Rain_1#只是出來做點工作#$r 32 50 Event_Rain_2#享受這種天氣#$r 32 10 Event_Rain_3#我也可以問你同樣的問題"/faceDirection Abigail 1/pause 1250/speak Abigail "……我是來這裡獨處的。$8"/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 1600/faceDirection Abigail 2/speak Abigail "不過我不介意你陪著！"/pause 500/emote Abigail 40/speak Abigail "你全身都溼透了……來樹下站吧。"/move farmer -1 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 2/faceDirection Abigail 1/pause 3000/speak Abigail "這種感覺難以形容……看著雨幕在寂靜的湖面上低語。$8"/pause 650/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 600/playSound dwop/showFrame 98/pause 500/faceDirection Abigail 3/emote Abigail 16/pause 800/speak Abigail "嘿！是迷你豎琴！$h#$b#你總能讓人意外，@。真令人刮目相看。"/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 900/emote farmer 56/faceDirection Abigail 3/pause 700/faceDirection Abigail 2/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 500/showFrame Abigail 16/pause 500/showFrame 98/pause 2000/playMusic AbigailFluteDuet/pause 1250/animate Abigail false true 612 16 17 18 19/animate farmer false true 308 99 98 98 99 100 100/pause 10000/viewport move 1 0 18000/pause 20000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 2000/end

pause 500/playMusic none/pause 500/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/loadActors MainEvent/warpFarmers 29 70 0 26 68 1 27 70 0 33 68 3 33 70 3 30 71 0 29 72 0 27 72 0 left 34 70 3/pause 1000/positionOffset Demetrius 5 -10/positionOffset Jodi 5 -8/positionOffset Marnie -12 10/positionOffset Shane -6 -6/viewport 29 69 true unfreeze/pause 2000/speak Lewis "今天的節慶終於來到重頭戲……一年一度的春季尋蛋活動！$h"/pause 100/jump Jas/jump Vincent/pause 1000/speak Lewis "孩子們，先冷靜一下。想找到最多彩蛋、把獨家獎品帶回家，就得保留所有體力。"/pause 100/faceDirection Vincent 1 true/faceDirection Jas 3 true/pause 1000/faceDirection Vincent 0 true/faceDirection Jas 0/pause 800/faceDirection Lewis 3/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 125/faceDirection Lewis 1/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 800/speak Lewis "那麼……大家準備好了嗎？"/pause 1000/waitForOtherPlayers startContest/jump Lewis/pause 1000/speak Lewis "尋蛋活動開始！$h"/advancedMove Abigail false -2 0 0 -3 -7 0 0 -2 -2 0 0 -5 1 0 0 -4 -3 0 0 5 -2 0 0 14 54 0/advancedMove Sam false 0 11 26 0 0 15 -14 0 0 -5 -9 0 0 -9 6 0 0 8 -4 0/advancedMove Jas false 0 1 3 0 0 1 15 0 0 -8 7 0 0 9 -7 0 0 7 -20 0 0 10 -21 0/advancedMove Vincent false 4 300 1 400 1 0 0 1 3 0 0 1 15 0 0 -8 7 0 0 9 -7 0 0 7 -20 0 0 10 -20 0/advancedMove Maru false 0 -4 2 0 0 -3 3 0 0 -2 12 0 0 -6 19 0 0 19 -31 0 0 -10/advancedMove Leo false 0 2 -2 0 0 1 -3 0 0 1 -5 0 0 2 22 0 0 -4 30 0 0 -18 -15 0/advancedMove Haley true 3 7000 2 5000/advancedMove Gus true 1 5500 0 -2 4 400 1 7000 2 400 0 2 2 400 1 1000/playSound whistle/playMusic tickTock/playerControl eggHunt

EmilyTheme/-1000 -1000/farmer 8 14 3 Emily 7 14 1/makeInvisible 8 14/viewport -100 -100 true unfreeze/pause 3000/speak Emily "歡迎回家，@。希望你今天過得愉快。"/pause 1000/emote farmer 20/pause 1200/speak Emily "所以……我完成了之前在做的祕密計畫。"/emote farmer 8/pause 500/speak Emily "這是一套全新、親手替你製作的服裝！$h"/pause 500/awardFestivalPrize emilyClothes/pause 500/playSound coin/message "收到了艾蜜莉的魔法帽、艾蜜莉的魔法靴、艾蜜莉的魔法上衣，以及一條成套的褲子！"/pause 500/speak Emily "我一直很喜歡縫紉和做手工……所以想親手做些東西給你。製作過程非常開心！#$b#希望尺寸合適……而且纖維不會太刺癢。#$b#有靴子、帽子、上衣和褲子！是一整套服裝。"/pause 800/speak Emily "以後穿上這套衣服時，你就會想到我……也會知道我在這裡等你平安回家……好嗎？$l"/pause 500/faceDirection Emily 2/pause 500/animate Emily false true 250 52 53/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/faceDirection farmer 2 true/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/pause 250/playSound dwop/positionOffset Emily 4 0/pause 250/stopAnimation Emily/pause 3000/showFrame Emily 55/pause 500/eyes 1 -4500/pause 3000/fade/viewport -100 -100/pause 500/end dialogue Emily "該睡了。"
